117797.name: Chabad Lubavitch Of Southern Ontario
117797.note: Lubavitch.com on CrownHeights.info, 3 Jan 2012: Rabbi Zalman Aaron Grossbaum, 'director of Chabad of Southern Ontario since 1974'. Medium: CrownHeights.info, 17 June 2021, says 'the Grossbaums arrived in the area in 1980 as some of the first emissaries sent to Toronto' (Vaughan).

117798.name: Jewish Russian Community Centre of Ontario
117798.note: Lubavitch.com on CrownHeights.info, 11 Aug 2026: 'The JRCC was founded in Toronto in 1980 by Rabbi Yoseph Yitzchak Zaltzman, who was sent by the Lubavitcher Rebbe to serve what was then roughly a thousand Russian Jewish families.'

117795.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Markham
117795.note: CrownHeights.info, 14 June 2026 ('Chabad Markham Celebrates 40 Years'): the Plotkins 'thanked the community that embraced them when they arrived in Markham in 1985'.

117792.name: Friends of Lubavitch
117792.note: Chabad.org, 8 Oct 2017 (Dr. Yitzchok Block obituary, read through Firecrawl; the page links this listing): 'In 1986, heeding the Rebbe's call to open more Jewish institutions around the world, the Blocks founded a Chabad House in London, today headed by Rabbi Mordechai and Nechamie Silberberg.' The Blocks had come to London earlier, when he joined the University of Western Ontario.

118329.name: Chabad Flamingo
118329.note: Lubavitch.com, 16 Dec 2002: Chabad at Flamingo opened the Ernest Manson Lubavitch Center 'in time for Rosh Hashana of 1999'; 'Chabad's presence in the neighborhood had been established just one year earlier, with the arrival of Rabbi Mendel and Faygie Kaplan'.

326603.name: Bais Chomesh Girls High School
326603.note: Jewish Toronto directory: 'The school established in 1999 is named after the Rebbitzen Chaya Mushka Schneerson'. Medium: a directory entry.

118663.name: Chabad Jewish Discovery Centre
118663.note: CrownHeights.info, 21 Sept 2011: 'Rabbi Slavin, who started Chabad of Mississauga in 2003'. Medium: CrownHeights.info, 1 Aug 2012, says 'The Slavins opened run the non-denominational Jewish centre four years ago' (perhaps the building).

608335.name: Jewish Youth Network
608335.note: CrownHeights.info, 17 June 2021: Rabbi Shmuli Nachlas 'has co-directed the Chabad-Lubavitch Jewish Youth Network (JYN) along with his wife, Chani, since 2007'; 'The Nachlas family moved to Ontario in 2001 and began working with youth in Ontario in 2007.' Its chabad.org listing went up 9 Dec 2007.

1082813.name: Chabad of Durham Region
1082813.note: CrownHeights.info, 28 Dec 2013: Rabbi Tzali Borenstein, 'who opened the centre upon moving to the region with his family from New York in 2010.' Its chabad.org listing went up 1 Jan 2010.

5361702.name: Chabad Innisfil
5361702.note: Lubavitch.com, 5 Aug 2026: 'That changed in 2021, when Rabbi Zevi and Mussy Kaplan moved to town to establish a year-round Chabad presence.' Its chabad.org listing went up 18 Jan 2022.
